description: Agent notification toast ('Inbox agent finished') covered the Undo/Dismiss bar after a Contacts delete; clicking Undo failed because another element sat on top.
expected: Undo stays reachable while other toasts appear.
actual: Undo button at the bottom right of the bar was covered; click rejected as covered by the toast.
suggested_fix: Stack the toasts (offset the Undo bar) or place the Undo bar where toasts do not appear.
